manufacturerInfo.name: Yean Shing Technology
manufacturerInfo.description: Ni-Zn ferrite for common-mode chokes, mu_i 730, stated by the maker for 10/100/1000BASE CMCs and 100-200 MHz filtering. Permeability and the loss factor are the maker's own, the latter read from their published loss-factor curve. SATURATION IS ESTIMATED: Yean Shing publish no Bs, and 390 mT is the median of every NiZn grade at this permeability (leave-one-out control over 345 records: median 1.000, 79 % within +/-25 %). Note the EMI-suppression NiZn grades that publish a Bs sit lower -- Fair-Rite 43 250 mT, Encore N1 280 mT, Ferronics J 295 mT. Resistivity is omitted rather than guessed -- NiZn grades at this permeability span five decades and the maker does not publish it.
